scope: Unsigned publisher inventory of complete payload, supporting preparation file and exact archive bytes. Actual GitHub carrier identity is assigned externally after read-back; no timestamp, authorship or truth attestation.

zip_construction.members: All regular payload files plus the parent preparation file in lexicographic path order; no directory entries, symlinks or empty directories.
zip_construction.root: Exact PREPARATION.md plus complete payload/ subtree; current outer card/citation/publication metadata excluded.
zip_construction.timestamp_meaning: Fixed container metadata, not an assertion about creation, execution or publication time.
